# Kinetic documentary recipe

## Look
Narration turned into picture: a black-and-white archive documentary with a single warm red. Each word lands on the exact frame it is spoken, inside one centred line of small words, with one heavy condensed caps word beneath. Each line that carries meaning gets one literal picture staged as a physical object. Options: a print laid over a blurred duplicate of itself; a window on black growing through three sizes; instant photos spread on a grey page. The turn of the story stands alone on a grey vignette page with the turn word in red. If the speaker's face appears, it stays in colour, untouched. The payoff is the slowest, cleanest stretch: a quote typed on warm paper, one red word, a hard end.

## Core rules
- Words land on the voice. A caption word turns on in a single frame, at the moment it is spoken, sitting where it will stay in a line that was laid out beforehand. No fade, scale, slide or bounce. The line clears when its phrase ends.
- One idea, one heavy word. A phrase = one centred line of small words, with heavy condensed caps beneath for at most one big word (or two short). Stress through scale, caps, a red box, or a page to itself. A per-word colour sweep is out. Serif italic is the voice for quotes and coined terms.
- Pictures are literal objects. Show the noun of the line (a cup on "cangkir", a stall on "warung") as a print, window or instant photo. Reach for a metaphor solely when the line is abstract. All pictures black and white.
- One world, one red. Black-and-white pictures; grey vignette pages; warm paper for the quotes and the finish; red for the payoff word, turn word, label box, counter, strike.
- Hard cuts on phrase starts. Land something new about every 1.25 s, except in the payoff, which runs slow and clean.

Not this: a news package (tickers, lower-third crawl); kinetic type on a colour field (pictures carry the film); a colour-graded vlog (black and white belongs to pictures, never to the speaker's skin). Ban dissolves, flash frames, glitches, letterboxes, split screens, outlined text over pictures and an end fade.

## Media handling
- Speaker (talking-head format): the user's clip from `list_media`, full frame, in colour, as shot. No grade, no grain, no dimming. Caption block lives in the chest band: top = max(1130, chin + 60), never below y 1500. Reframe a horizontal clip to 9:16 (craft `reframe.md`).
- Voice-over or footage-only formats: each moment is a scene. Pictures sit in the upper middle (print box up to 980 x 880, centred on y 745). Caption block top at 1240.
- Timing: land each word on its `start` from the `inspect_media` transcript (`words: [{text, start, end}]`). Confirm names, years and amounts with the user.
- Pictures: the user's photos and clips that do not contain the speaker, made black and white with `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.25)`, set once and never tweened. Archive or drawn stills also work. No crowds or group photos.
- Print: sharp picture over its own blurred, darkened copy that fills the frame (blur about 30 px, brightness 45%, drawn once). Slow push x1.06.
- Window: the picture inside a thin white frame on black. It steps up through three sizes four frames apart, then pushes slowly.
- Instant photos: white cards with a soft shadow on the grey page, a serif italic label under each picture, one card per word.
- Texture: grain overlay at 7% (overlay blend), drawn once, plus a radial falloff. Both on pages and pictures only, never on the speaker.
- The example paints a stand-in speaker and archive pictures once. Swap in the user's clip, photos and footage.

## Colour
- `--utama` is the single red: label box (words in `--teks-di-utama`), counter box, a strike. A red word on a page (turn word, payoff word) uses `--utama-di-latar`.
- `--latar`: grey page, as a radial vignette from `--latar` to `--latar` mixed 28% toward `--teks` at the edges. `--latar-2`: warm paper for quotes and the end. Words on both: `--teks`. Serif label: `--teks-redup`.
- `--aksen`: pale sub-line strip under a label, words in `--teks-di-aksen`.
- Fixed for every brand: `--hitam` (black of windows and print surround); `--putih` (captions over pictures and the speaker, with a soft dark glow, never an outline); instant-photo white and its ink; the black-and-white pictures themselves. Speaker footage keeps its own colours.
- On a dark brand, pages and paper go dark and words go light. Red still marks one thing per beat.

## Type
- Small words, `--font-isi`: 600, 62 px (shrink to fit 940 px), sentence case, word spacing 0.32 em. White with a soft glow over pictures; 78 px in `--teks` on pages. Inter works.
- Heavy word, `--font-judul`: 700 caps, up to 168 px beneath the small words (fit 940 px), 210 px alone on a page. Label boxes: 76 px caps on red. Oswald or any condensed grotesk.
- Serif voice: Playfair Display Italic 400. Picture labels 54-64 px; quotes and coined terms.
- Numbers: Playfair Display 700 upright, 220 px, inside a red box, counting up.
- Typewriter: IBM Plex Mono 400, 66 px, roughly one character per frame, blinking bar cursor, on warm paper.

## Timing and motion
- 30 fps. Hard cuts, placed on sentence starts or phrase breaks. No fade at the end.
- Caption words: one frame each, toggled with `visibility` at the word's start, at the final position. The line clears with its phrase. Never tween text.
- Turn page: a black block the size of the word appears 3 frames ahead, then the word takes its place.
- Pictures push x1.05-1.06 across their time with `power1.inOut`. The speaker pushes x1.05 over the first 1.1 s of the film, plus up to three 2-frame snap punch-ins on stressed words.
- Window sizes: x0.62, x0.8, x1, four frames apart, then a slow push.
- Label: red box wipes on left to right in 0.5 s `power3.out` (clip-path), sub-line strip arriving with it.
- Counter: counts up in about 1 s with `power2.out`, one value per frame at the end. Its box opens left to right in 0.3 s.
- Instant photos: one per word. The camera slides to the newest in 0.35 s eased; earlier cards remain at the edge.
- Typewriter: one character per frame; once the line is done, the cursor blinks every 0.25 s.
- Outside the payoff, add something new about every 1.25 s. A full-screen picture or page over a talking head lasts 2.5 s at most.

## Camera moves
- Face push x1.05 over 1.1 s: we lean in. For the opening line.
- Slow push x1.06 on a print: look closer at the evidence. For every picture.
- Window step-up in three sizes: the picture is pulled from the archive. For a number or a single object.
- Slide to the newest instant photo in 0.35 s: the story moves on, the past waits at the edge. For lists, timelines, steps.
- 2-frame snap punch-in: stress. Three per film, tops.
- Hidden cut inside motion (an object crossing, a page turning): a seamless chapter change. Once per film.
- Hard cut on the phrase start: default for everything else.

## Signature moves
- Pop-on line with one heavy word: small words appear one frame each on their onsets, heavy caps word beneath. "Kakek saya membuka WARUNG KOPI"; a teacher's "Hari ini kita bahas GRAVITASI"; a creator's "Video ini ditonton SEJUTA kali"; "Malam itu semuanya BERUBAH".
- Print with red label: literal picture over its blurred copy, a red caps label wiping on, a pale sub-line giving place or year. A shop's first stall "1974 · Pasar Cempaka"; a school's old building; a product's first batch; a village in a family story.
- Window and counter: picture in a window on black, stepping up; a red box with a number counting up; the unit in small words. "40 cangkir sehari"; "120 murid"; "3 juta penonton"; "7 tahun".
- Turn page: the turn line alone on the grey vignette page; a black block holds the turn word's place for 3 frames, then the word appears in red. "Lalu pasarnya TERBAKAR"; "Tapi ternyata SALAH"; "Dan semuanya HILANG".
- Instant photo run: cards on the grey page, one per word, serif labels with years, camera sliding to the newest while the heavy word changes. Tent, cart, kiosk; three shop branches; a student's three projects; chapters of a family's move.
- Typed payoff: warm paper, the quote typed in mono one character per frame, payoff word in red, serif attribution. Nothing else lands. Hard end. "Kopi yang jujur selalu ditunggu."; a founder's motto; a teacher's last lesson; a story's moral.

## Avoid
- Words that fade, scale or slide in. Per-word colour sweep or karaoke highlight.
- Two or more heavy words in one phrase; a second display family.
- Colour pictures; a speaker turned black and white, dimmed or grained.
- Red on more than one thing per beat, or red as decoration.
- Crowds, group photos, stock clips of strangers; metaphors when a literal picture exists.
- Dissolves, flash frames, glitches, fade-out ending, outlined text over pictures.
- Rescuing a long picture with extra cuts. Land something on it instead: a label, a counter, a punch-in, the next heavy word.
- Sound effects under caption words or under the payoff.

## Reference numbers
- 48-105 visual events a minute across the references; about 1.25 s between new things outside the payoff.
- Caption sizes: small words 62 px Inter; heavy word to 168 px condensed caps; page words 78 / 210 px; labels 54 px serif; typewriter 66 px mono. Caption block top 1240 in picture formats; chest band 1130-1500 with a speaker.
- Talking-head budgets: face on screen at least 65% of the film; each full-screen picture or page at most 2.5 s; at most 3 inserts a minute.
- Source red #D63A2F: white on it 4.7:1, on black 4.5:1, on the grey page 3.4:1 (display sizes only).
- Sound placement: a flat bed about 19 dB under the voice, never ducked. Effects only under picture events: a whoosh 0.12 s before a picture cut, one into a page, a tick per counter value, a swoosh under a label, a shutter under an instant photo. None under caption words; nothing under the payoff.

# Kinetic documentary: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.3, medium 2.0, long 3.0.

## hook

- en: the face pushes in x1.05, words pop on one frame each, one heavy caps word; hard cut to a B&W print of the anchor with a red label
- id: wajah didorong ×1,05, kata muncul satu frame tiap kata, satu kata besar kapital; potong keras ke cetakan hitam-putih dengan label merah

## problem

- en: the turn line alone on a grey vignette page, a black block the size of the word one beat ahead, the turn word in red
- id: kalimat belokan sendirian di halaman abu bervinyet, balok hitam seukuran kata muncul lebih dulu, kata belokannya merah

## fact

- en: one literal B&W picture as a print over its own blurred copy, slow push, a red caps label with a pale sub-line
- id: satu gambar hitam-putih harfiah sebagai cetakan di atas salinan buramnya, dorong pelan, label merah kapital dengan pita terang

## step

- en: instant photos on the grey page, one per step word, the camera sliding to the newest; the heavy word changes with each
- id: instant photo di halaman abu, satu per kata langkah, kamera bergeser ke yang terbaru; kata besarnya ikut berganti

## compare

- en: two prints cut hard on the phrase start, the losing one struck through with a red line
- id: dua cetakan dipotong keras di awal frasa, yang kalah dicoret garis merah

## number

- en: a window on black stepping up in three sizes, a red upright numeral counting up, the unit as small words
- id: jendela di atas hitam naik tiga ukuran, angka merah tegak menghitung naik, satuannya kata kecil

## proof

- en: instant photos of the evidence on the grey page with serif labels, one per word, the camera sliding to each
- id: instant photo bukti di halaman abu dengan label serif, satu per kata, kamera bergeser ke tiap instant photo

## offer

- en: the offer as a red label box wiping on over its print, the price as the heavy caps word
- id: tawaran sebagai kotak label merah tersapu di atas cetakannya, harga sebagai kata besar kapital

## cta

- en: warm paper, the ask typed in mono a character a frame, the contact in serif italic under it, held 2 s
- id: kertas hangat, ajakan diketik mono satu huruf per frame, kontak serif miring di bawahnya, diam 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: the face, then warm paper: the quote typed, the payoff word in red, nothing else landing; a hard end
- id: wajah, lalu kertas hangat: kutipan diketik, kata payoff merah, tak ada yang lain muncul; berakhir potong keras
